name: Terahara Saori
source:
A long-time acquaintance of the protagonists, and a self-proclaimed "reliable onee-chan".

She is also a teacher at the school the protagonists attend. A self-proclaimed "capable teacher".

She is a harmless and good person, and is somehow able to get by with the help of those around her.

[translated from [url=http://wonder-fool.jp/ningyohime/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
